title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the ground state energy E.

title: Final Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct normalized wave function psi(r).

title: Correct Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the boundary conditions at r = a and r = b.

title: K Value Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct values for K based on the boundary conditions.

title: Normalization Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the normalization condition to find the constant A.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the expressions for K or E.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all factors in the wave function and energy expressions are included.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios for additional insight.
